publicReleaseNotes: Purse 0.2.0 adds an agent door with company money limits and named-person approvals, SAML sign-in, cross-team reviews, supplier tax and shipment records, deposits, travel requests, internal comments with search, and a Business that can run Purse with mail off. The hosted demo now starts in seconds: its sample suppliers are screened against a sample list instead of downloading the live screening list twelve times, and each published release redeploys the demo. Built with rer 0.2.140.
agentUpdateInstructions: Retain the previous source and a private native export. Follow OPERATIONS.md for same-release recovery before upgrading; preserve existing migration bytes and installation secrets. The thirteen migrations 0038 to 0050 apply in order on the next deploy.
